name: Alkhorayef Water and Power Technologies Company
summary: Alkhorayef Water and Power Technologies Company, together with its subsidiaries, designs, constructs, operates, maintains, and manages water and wastewater projects in Saudi Arabia. The company operates through three segments: Water, Waste Water, and Integrated Water Solutions. It provides engineering, procurement, and construction; and operation and maintenance services to wastewater plants, water treatment plants, and other water related infrastructure, such as storm water networks.
